verdictEs: FilterBlade si querés el filter más completo y mantenido del juego (el de NeverSink) con tier strictness avanzado. PoE Filter si preferís minimalismo y un look que respete la estética visual original de PoE sin tantos esconder/colorear.
verdictEn: FilterBlade if you want the most complete and maintained filter (NeverSink's) with advanced tier strictness. PoE Filter if you prefer minimalism and a look that respects PoE's original visual aesthetic without heavy hiding and coloring.

useCases.labelEs: Endgame con tier strictness alto y maintenance por league
useCases.labelEn: Endgame with high tier strictness and per-league maintenance
useCases.reasonEs: NeverSink actualiza su filter con cada parche y FilterBlade es la interfaz oficial para customizarlo.
useCases.reasonEn: NeverSink updates his filter each patch and FilterBlade is the official interface to customize it.

useCases.labelEs: Empezar con un filter simple y limpio
useCases.labelEn: Starting with a simple, clean filter
useCases.reasonEs: Foco minimalista que respeta la estética del juego; menos overwhelming para nuevos jugadores.
useCases.reasonEn: Minimalist focus that respects the game's aesthetic; less overwhelming for new players.

useCases.labelEs: Integración con economía y precios en vivo
useCases.labelEn: Integration with live economy and prices

useCases.reasonEn: PoE Filter ships with native poe.ninja integration to adjust tiers based on real per-league market value.
